title: THE BULWARK REDESIGN
why: His order of 2026-10-12: improve the sprites of all characters and machines, silhouettes first. The Bulwark shield was light blue-grey, the same steel as human armour, the body behind it a dark lozenge on two pebbles, and the shield hung below its own shadow. Now it is a squat walker on two stompy feet that step as it moves, a hunched body set back behind the shield with one sensor eye on top that shows its mood, and a dark gunmetal shield with rust edges, a yellow and black chevron band along the top, rivets and a viewing slit that glows with the eye. The shield stands on the ground and keeps its chevrons up whichever way it turns. Elite Bulwarks have a brass shield edge. Drawn only: its size, its shield and its weak back are unchanged.
now: The Bulwark is redrawn: a squat walker behind a dark chevron-striped shield with a glowing viewing slit.
